_meta.workstream: B / C - Food, cafes, gaming, activities, landmarks
_meta.purpose: Places to eat, drink and go, oriented to the actual base of this trip: AX Odycy on the Qawra seafront. Every entry carries its source; nothing is asserted without one.
_meta.rating_caveat: Ratings and review counts below are point-in-time figures read from aggregator listings on 9 Oct 2026. They are NOT re-verified at the venue and will drift. Google Maps, Yelp, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and X could not be queried directly from this environment (login walls / no API access) - see docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md OQ-06.

on_site.name: Minoa Mediterranean Fusion
on_site.hours: Not published at check time - ask reception
on_site.description: Adults-only Mediterranean fusion restaurant on the rooftop of AX Odycy with panoramic sea views. Ranked in the island's Definitive(ly) Good Guide 2026 top ten.
on_site.notes: Adults-only per the operator's own page - not a family option. Zero travel time from the room.

on_site.name: Trattoria Riccardo
on_site.description: Italian with a wood-fired oven, pasta and a children's play area, positioned on the Qawra promenade with sea views.
on_site.notes: The operator describes it as often ranked among the top Italian restaurants in Malta. That is a marketing claim, not an independent ranking - not repeated as fact.

on_site.name: Cheeky Monkey Gastropub
on_site.description: Lively gastropub with cocktails, hearty food and a wide beer list - the natural place to watch the tournament if the hotel screens it.
on_site.notes: Third-party aggregator shows 4.3 from 2,428 reviews at check time. Whether it screens CS2 matches is NOT verified - ask on arrival.

on_site.name: Mamacita
on_site.description: Latin-inspired restaurant on the AX Odycy site.
on_site.notes: Direct line +356 2354 3565 from the operator's structured data.

on_site.name: Luzzu
on_site.notes: Named on the operator's Qawra restaurant index; the specific AX property hosting it is not stated there - confirm at reception.

on_site.name: Also on the AX Odycy site: Minoa Deck, Medusa, Espresso, Sidestreet Lounge Bar, Cheeky Monkey Waters, Cheeky Monkey Creperie
on_site.description: Six further on-site outlets named in the operator's own structured data: a rooftop deck bar, a bar, a coffee spot, a lounge bar, a waterside bar and a creperie.
on_site.notes: Espresso direct line +356 2158 5501; Minoa Deck +356 2158 5501 (same number, per the operator's structured data - possibly a shared switchboard).

nearby.name: Royale Barrel Bistro Bar
nearby.address: Dawret il-Qawra, Qawra, St Paul's Bay SPB 1900
nearby.description: Brew pub and bistro on the same coast road as the hotel - the closest independent option to AX Odycy and a plausible place to watch matches over beer.
nearby.notes: 4.8 from 195 reviews at check time. Address and rating read from a TripAdvisor ranked-list snippet, not from the venue's own site.

nearby.name: Nine Lives
nearby.address: St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.description: Bar and contemporary kitchen, consistently at the top of the St Paul's Bay view-restaurant lists.
nearby.notes: 4.7 from 2,719 reviews at check time. Street address not captured - look it up before going.

nearby.name: Venus Restaurant
nearby.address: Bugibba, St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.description: Steakhouse and seafood. The strongest cross-platform signal in the area: top of the TripAdvisor St Paul's Bay list AND top-five in the island's diner-voted Definitive(ly) Good Guide 2026.
nearby.notes: 4.8 from 2,891 reviews at check time. The Definitive(ly) Good Guide 2026 top-five placement was verified on restaurantsmalta.com in the previous session and is recorded on restaurants.html.

nearby.name: Sole by Tarragon
nearby.address: St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.description: Seafood with sea views. Ranked #2 overall in the island's Definitive(ly) Good Guide 2026 and took Best Service and Best Local Fish.
nearby.notes: The guide placement was verified against restaurantsmalta.com in the previous session (recorded on restaurants.html); the 2026 edition's rankings come from a September 2025 reader survey, so they are about a year old by trip time. Street address not captured this session.

nearby.name: Cafe del Mar Malta
nearby.address: St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.hours: Not published at check time; seasonal operation likely in mid-October - confirm
nearby.description: Seaside venue with a pool, sunset views, cocktails and live music. The highest-volume single venue in the area.
nearby.notes: 4.4 from 7,963 reviews at check time via a third-party aggregator. Whether the pool/beach-club side is still open in mid-October is NOT verified - this is the main risk in recommending it.

nearby.name: La Buona Trattoria del Nonno
nearby.address: St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.description: Traditional Italian and Mediterranean in a cosy setting; a common family-dinner choice in the area.

nearby.name: Ta' Pawla Mother Earth Restaurant
nearby.address: St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.description: Maltese cooking in a rustic setting, focused on local ingredients and traditional recipes - the best nearby option for actually eating Maltese food.

nearby.name: Woodhut Pub & Diner
nearby.address: St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.description: Cosy rustic pub with comfort food, drinks and live entertainment.

nearby.name: The Sea Cloud - Bistro & Cocktail Bar
nearby.address: St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.description: Relaxed sea-view bistro and cocktail bar with an international menu.

nearby.name: 23 Steps Pub & Diner
nearby.address: St Paul's Bay (exact street not captured at check time)
nearby.description: Bar with a view and simple fresh food; the cheapest reliable option on the nearby lists.
nearby.notes: 4.2 from 70 reviews at check time - a small sample, so treat the rating as soft.

activities_landmarks.name: Mdina and Rabat
activities_landmarks.hours: Public town, open access; individual attractions have their own hours
activities_landmarks.price_range: Free to walk; museum and palace entries priced separately
activities_landmarks.description: The fortified old capital and the town below it. Reached directly from the hotel's own bus line - route 186 terminates at Rabat and runs past the Mdina stop, every 30 minutes, with no change of bus.
activities_landmarks.notes: Bus reachability verified from the operator's route page. Third-party distance data puts Mdina about 7.8 km from the hotel. Entry prices for Mdina attractions were verified in the previous session on landmarks.html and are not restated here.

activities_landmarks.name: Ta' Qali: National Stadium, Malta Aviation Museum and Ta' Qali Craft Village
activities_landmarks.address: Ta' Qali, Attard ATD 4000 - the same complex as the tournament venue
activities_landmarks.hours: Attraction hours not published at check time
activities_landmarks.price_range: Free to walk the area; attractions priced separately
activities_landmarks.description: The venue is inside a wider leisure complex, so on a non-match morning the same 30-minute bus ride reaches the craft village and aviation museum area. Route 186 serves both 'Ta' Qali Stadium' and 'Ta' Qali Villagg' stops.
activities_landmarks.notes: The two Ta' Qali stop names are on the operator's route 186 stop list. Attraction opening hours and prices were NOT verified this session.

activities_landmarks.name: Mosta Rotunda (Mosta Dome)
activities_landmarks.price_range: Free to enter; dome climb priced separately (not verified)
activities_landmarks.description: One of the largest unreinforced church domes in the world, and a stop on the hotel's own bus line roughly 20 minutes out.
activities_landmarks.notes: Bus reachability verified (Rotunda 4 at 06:27 on the first outbound run). The 'one of the largest domes' claim is widely repeated but was NOT checked against an authoritative source this session.

activities_landmarks.name: Valletta
activities_landmarks.address: Valletta - route 45 from the Qawra seafront stops
activities_landmarks.hours: City, open access; attractions have their own hours
activities_landmarks.price_range: Free to walk; attractions priced separately
activities_landmarks.description: The capital, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Bus route 45 runs from the Qawra seafront stops (Arznell, Luzzu, Qawra, Boxxla, Fugass, Wileg) to Valletta.
activities_landmarks.notes: Route 45's Qawra stops are verified from the operator's stop listings. WARNING: a 2025 third-party atlas records route 45 as peak-hours-only (Mon-Fri) - the operator's page was not read closely enough this session to confirm or deny that. Check the tallinja app before planning an off-peak Valletta day on route 45.

activities_landmarks.name: Sliema and St Julian's
activities_landmarks.address: Sliema - route 212 from the Bugibba/Qawra area
activities_landmarks.description: The seafront shopping and nightlife belt. Route 212 links Bugibba to Sliema and serves the Qawra seafront stops.
activities_landmarks.notes: Route 212's Qawra stops verified from the operator's stop listings (Arznell, Luzzu, Qawra, Boxxla, Fugass, Wileg).

activities_landmarks.name: Gozo via Cirkewwa ferry terminal
activities_landmarks.address: Cirkewwa ferry terminal - route 221 or TD1 from the Qawra/Bugibba area
activities_landmarks.hours: Ferry timetable not re-verified this session
activities_landmarks.price_range: Bus on the day fare or card; ferry fare see getting-around.html
activities_landmarks.description: The Gozo Channel ferry leaves from Cirkewwa at the island's northern tip. Route 221 (Bugibba→Cirkewwa) and Airport Direct TD1 both serve the Qawra seafront stops.
activities_landmarks.notes: Bus reachability verified. Gozo Channel fares were verified against gozochannel.com in the previous session (see getting-around.html); the timetable was not re-read this session.

activities_landmarks.name: Ghajn Tuffieha and Golden Bay beaches
activities_landmarks.address: Ghajn Tuffieha - route 223 from the Qawra/Bugibba area
activities_landmarks.description: The island's best-known sandy beaches on the north-west coast, reachable by route 223 (Bugibba→Ghajn Tuffieha), which serves the Qawra seafront stops.
activities_landmarks.notes: Route 223's Qawra stops verified from the operator's stop listings. Mid-October sea conditions are not guaranteed.

activities_landmarks.name: Popeye Village
activities_landmarks.address: Anchor Bay, Mellieha - the official stop list contains 'Bus Stop 1005 Popeye'
activities_landmarks.description: The 1980 film set turned family attraction. It has its own numbered bus stop in the operator's national stop list, which is evidence it is on the network - but no route serving it from Qawra was verified this session.
activities_landmarks.notes: Deliberately recorded as unverified. The stop's existence is verified; the route from Qawra, the opening hours and the ticket price are not. Do not present this as a confirmed option until a route is checked in the tallinja journey planner.

activities_landmarks.name: Gaming centres / LAN venues near Qawra
activities_landmarks.description: NO gaming centre or LAN venue within reach of Qawra could be verified this session. The one venue named in previous work on this site (Gamers Lounge) has no published session rates and no verified Qawra-area branch.
activities_landmarks.notes: This is an honest gap, not an omission. Recorded in docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md OQ-05 rather than filled with a guess. The practical substitute for LAN time during the trip is the tournament venue itself plus the hotel's own wifi.
